name: Manhattan Village
summary: Manhattan Village is the South Bay's premier open-air lifestyle center, offering an upscale shopping and dining experience tailored to the affluent beach communities of Manhattan Beach and surrounding areas. This well-established destination combines national retailers with specialty shops in a sophisticated coastal California setting.
demographics: Manhattan Village attracts an affluent, educated demographic reflective of the South Bay beach communities, with median household incomes exceeding $150,000. The primary trade area draws families and professionals aged 30-55 from Manhattan Beach, Hermosa Beach, and El Segundo, with a strong presence of dual-income households with children. Shoppers tend to be style-conscious consumers who value quality and convenience, seeking a mix of fashion, dining, and lifestyle services in an upscale open-air environment. The center also captures significant spending from nearby aerospace and tech professionals working in the El Segundo corridor.
description: Manhattan Village stands as the South Bay's premier open-air shopping destination, serving the affluent beach communities of Manhattan Beach and surrounding areas since its establishment. Located at 3200 North Sepulveda Boulevard, this upscale lifestyle center has evolved into a sophisticated retail hub that perfectly captures the relaxed yet refined sensibility of coastal Southern California living. The center features a carefully curated mix of national retailers, specialty boutiques, and dining establishments that cater to the discerning tastes of local residents and visitors alike. With its open-air design, the property offers a pleasant shopping experience enhanced by the area's ideal climate and proximity to the Pacific Ocean. Manhattan Village has maintained its position as a community gathering place, combining retail therapy with lifestyle amenities that reflect the active, health-conscious culture of the South Bay, making it an essential destination for both everyday needs and special shopping occasions.
